command.forged_depths.info.title: Forged Depths — the Forgotten Forge of the Ancients
command.forged_depths.info.line1: A dungeon buried below Y -50 under mountains, dark forests and the deep dark.
command.forged_depths.info.line2: Inside you take 2 hearts every 10 seconds — armour and charms soften it, but never past 70%.
command.forged_depths.info.line3: Nine room types, 5-8 per dungeon, laid out differently every time.
command.forged_depths.info.line4: The Anvil of the Ancients repairs anything free — 5 uses, 15% chance to destroy the item.
command.forged_depths.info.line5: /fd locate — find one · /fd status — your heat · /fd tp <x> <z> — jump in
